sources.entry: OS-intent - Learns how you work and puts your likely next action one key away, with every outward action behind a confirm panel.

summary.one_liner: OS-intent is a macOS prototype that learns your work habits locally, predicts your next action, and shows the likely options in a keyboard-driven cross around the pointer, with every outward action gated behind a confirm panel.
use_cases: Get one-key shortcuts to the next step you usually take
Draft mail replies saved to Drafts without sending
Send a voice note or screenshot to an agent after confirming
Surface new mail, meetings or agent messages as hints
Search a local markdown knowledge base for relevance
Run quick actions in Safari page buttons
notable: Predicts next actions with an order-2 Markov model on your own history, with an optional local language model in shadow mode
Hold the modifier keys to glide through follow-up options with context cards
Proactive hints appear as coloured dots and a ring when a monitored state changes
Every outward action waits for a confirm panel; nothing is sent automatically
Claude-assisted drafts and summaries run through your logged-in Claude Code CLI, and can be turned off
caveats: macOS 14+ only, and described as a working prototype with sharp edges in permissions and first-run setup
Requires several components: Swift toolchain, Python 3.12, ActivityWatch, and multiple install scripts and macOS permission grants
Claude features are ON by default and send HUD context to Claude unless disabled
